items.title: Michael Carrick facing Manchester United axe amid review by Jason Wilcox
items.summary: Director of football in discussions with Omar BerradaPochettino and Howe on radar as possible replacementsManchester United are moving towards sacking Michael Carrick, though no final decision has been made by Jason Wilcox, the director of football, who is leading the review after the head coach was given the Chelsea, Roma and Aston Villa games to turn results around.Wilcox has been consulting with Omar Berrada, the chief executive, before a recommendation regarding Carrick is made to Sir Jim Ratcliffe, who controls sporting policy.
